C44866.observed: No quick action appears on any search result row. Measured on the screen with a real mouse hover: two rounds over two queries (27 rows and 96 rows), 40 row-hovers in all, covering work orders, customers, assets, parts and vendors; then a second pass over 12 rows that watched the WHOLE page, not just the row, for any button appearing. Nothing appeared anywhere, and nothing appeared when the keyboard selection was moved either. The instrument is proved: every one of those hovers DID change the row on screen, and the same scan found 23 other buttons already on the page, so a quick action would have been seen. The owning story for this behaviour, SV-9173 (FE - Contextual quick actions on result rows), was read live in Jira on 21 September 2026 and its status is OBSOLETE, resolved Done. The story has been cancelled, so this cannot be judged as a product defect and no ticket is raised (Rule 112). The requirement is still written in the specification (page 576978945 version 17, section 8: 'show contextual quick actions on hover for each entity (desktop only)'), so the specification and the delivered scope now disagree. That disagreement is a question for the product owner, not a defect.
C44866.todo: Ask the product owner whether contextual quick actions are dropped from this release. If they are dropped, the specification needs updating and these cases are retired. If they are not dropped, the cancelled story has to be reopened. Do not raise a defect while the owning story is cancelled.
